column1: # mva_synthetic=true — four FABRICATED rows in the NCBI MANE summary layout.
# The marker is a factual assertion (ADR 0012), so it is worth being precise about
# what this is: the accession *names* are real, but the rows are not MANE rows.
# The version suffixes are deliberately wrong (BUB1B is ENST00000287598.12 here,
# .11 in MANE v1.5) and the MSH2 row is deliberately relabelled "MANE Plus
# Clinical" when the real release calls it "MANE Select".
# Both alterations are load-bearing. The wrong suffix proves the join matches on
# the unversioned accession, which is what makes SnpEff's ENST00000287598.11
# joinable to MANE at all. The relabelled MSH2 row is the only way to test that
# "MANE Plus Clinical" is NOT treated as MANE Select — two different claims that
# a join reading the status column carelessly would conflate.
# Consequently this file must never be mistaken for, or used as, a MANE release.
